newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daehan buys 21,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daehan buys 21,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd on Friday bought 21,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp, a Daehan Flour Mills official said.
The company official said shipment was set for June 5-July 5 to the western port of Inchon.

The official said the total amount would be split into four positions -- 7,500 tonnes of western white/soft white, 2,000 tonnes of western white (club minimum 15 percent), 2,500 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent), and 9,000 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
